title: Large-scale analysis of optimisation methods for parameter estimation problems in the life sciences: supplementary code and data
description:
Supplementary code and data for the paper Large-scale analysis of optimisation methods for parameter estimation problems in the life sciences by Stephan Grein, David R. Penas, Daniel Weindl, Polina Lakrisenko, Julio R. Banga, and Jan Hasenauer.

Code is licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License; data is licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA in the repository).
